facts.claim: Registration is a [[hooks]] array entry in ~/.kimi-code/config.toml (or $KIMI_CODE_HOME/config.toml) with exactly four keys: event, matcher?, command, timeout? (integer seconds 1-600, default 30)
A fifth key breaks config load: HookDefSchema is z.object(...).strict()
Matcher is an unanchored, case-sensitive JS RegExp tested against the tool name; empty or omitted matches all; an invalid regex matches nothing

Only deny works: exit 2 (stderr reason) or exit 0 with JSON hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision 'deny' (+ permissionDecisionReason). Any other permissionDecision, including allow and ask, is treated as allow with no effect on the normal permission flow; JSON is parsed only on exit 0
Empty deny reason becomes 'Blocked by PreToolUse hook'
No ask, no input rewrite, no fail-closed switch
facts.source: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/blob/0c63065fbd7386132b3b8c914de37adfff4c8daf/docs/en/customization/hooks.md (no such fields) and runHook.ts HookJsonOutputSchema (message, hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision/permissionDecisionReason/message only)

facts.claim: Timeout (process killed), spawn error, crash, other non-zero exit and invalid JSON all allow (fail-open)
Shell tool is Bash; MCP tools are mcp__<server>__<tool>; no separate MCP server field in the payload
Nothing a PreToolUse hook returns ends the whole run
